name: Fresh Beef Flank Steak (Sliced Thin Across the Grain)
whyItWorks: Very lean cut of beef with long longitudinal muscle fibers. When marinated in light coconut aminos and sliced across the grain into paper-thin strips, it requires minimal mastication.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sear quickly on high heat for 3 minutes per side. CRITICAL: Cut diagonally across the grain into very thin strips before eating.
